description:
Young, Black & Blue is my life experience. In a world that feels like it has been very slow to understand what it is to be black - from the different shades of our beauty to the intricacies of our diverse cultures - I’ve been slowly finding my own balance between my roots, self & identity. 

Having lived in 4 countries across 3 different continents, I’ve been blessed to be exposed to so many different cultures. The values I’ve picked up as a result, as well as the constant reminder from family, friends & loved ones to never forget my roots is the reason I am the man I am today. At only 27 years old, I am young, unapologetically black & sometimes blue – but healing.

On May 1st, Bandcamp will be waiving its cut of sales for the entire day - an initiative aimed at assisting artists during this trying times. As an independent artist I understand the value of creating quality music and the need to not compromise on said value and so I will be releasing my debut EP exclusively on Bandcamp and only for 24 hours on May 1st.
